A.note: RdRp, the ONLY CDS on RNA1 in this group: no subgenomic RNA3, no B1 and no B2 (PMID 21283608 searched for a +1 ORF with B2's properties and found none; PMID 23468484 found no silencing-suppressor activity for either Orsay protein tested). Orsay 937, Le Blanc 942, Santeuil 982. Melnik is partial at both ends with no complete CDS and no RefSeq

CP.note: Capsid protein, initiated at a NON-AUG codon. PMID 24503084 Edman-sequenced the Orsay mature N-terminus as NKNNT, corresponding to the AAC codon at RNA2 nt 89-91, with no AUG 5' of it in the segment; verified directly on HM030971 on 22 Nov 2026. Orsay 391, Santeuil 389, Le Blanc 388. Santeuil and Melnik deposits are 5'-truncated contigs that begin inside the gene and so start at Lys; they are excluded rather than used to train the profile

CP_DELTA.note: Capsid-delta fusion, made by a -1 PROGRAMMED RIBOSOMAL FRAMESHIFT at the slippery heptamer G_UCA_AAC, RNA2 nt 1255-1261, immediately 5' of the capsid stop, with a stimulatory stem-loop about 8 nt downstream and no pseudoknot (PMID 24503084); the transframe peptide was sequenced by MS/MS and the protein is a virion head fiber (PMIDs 32817218, 28241071). Verified on HM030971: nt 1255-1261 are GTCAAAC and the stop is the TAG at 1262-1264. Orsay and Santeuil 765, Le Blanc 827. RefSeq's join(89..1261,1261..2385) is this frameshift, NOT a splice

DELTA.note: Free delta, initiated at its own AUG (Orsay RNA2 nt 1345, verified on HM030971) and equal to the C-terminal part of the fusion. Orsay 346, Santeuil 332, Le Blanc 398. Its existence as a free protein was settled by an ATG-to-CTG mutant that still makes normal CP-delta but no free delta and has a non-lytic egress defect (PMID 29743360). ABSENT from RefSeq NC_028098.1 and present only in HM030971.2, which is why only 3 deposits exist. 46 of 46 extracted members are exact C-terminal substrings of the fusion from their own genome, beginning at fusion residue 419-434
